title: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 12 § 800.1 - Purpose
text:
This Part promulgates occupational safety and health
standards for the protection of the lives, safety and health of public
employees in compliance with the mandates of Labor Law, section
27-a.
